packageRules.description: The SGLang base image is a 16 GB pull and changes every backend image tag: its own PR, checked with the GPU lifecycle example before merging.

CI runs the versions the project supports at the bottom of its range: Python 3.12 (the private Aider engine), Node.js 20 (the stated minimum), and Ubuntu 22.04 for the .deb and AppImage builds (older glibc). Don't move them.
recheck and TypeScript are pinned for the regex check; a new version can change what it proves, so each gets its own PR.
